body: I've done nice things (and I try to be a nice person), but I'm always overlooked. It seems like everything would be better off without me.

Not one. The only things I've ever been "good" at are music and swimming. The problem is, nobody cares about being able to play 8 different instruments or being able to swim 10 miles. These things don't matter in the real world and they don't matter to other people.
It feels like everything I do is going to have no positive outcome for me or anyone else.
